slides.myth: AI will make my kid lazy.
slides.truth: Only if the AI is the one with the ideas.

slides.title:
Here, your kid
is the **director**
slides.body: They have the ideas and give the directions. They describe what they want, check the result and ask again.
slides.example: AI is a helper. Not a homework machine.

slides.title:
Want AI to do the homework?
**This isn't it.**
slides.body: Want your kid to make things they're proud of? Follow along.
